member.name: M:Yokko.Import.Bms.BmsChartImporter.channelRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^#(?<measure>\\d{3})(?<channel>[0-9A-Za-z]{2}):(?<data>.+)$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match '#'.
○ "measure" capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit exactly 3 times.
○ "channel" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z] exactly 2 times.
○ Match ':'.
○ "data" capture group.
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Yokko.Import.Etterna.EtternaChartImporter.tagRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
#(?<key>[^:;\\r\\n]+):(?<value>.*?);
Options:
RegexOptions.Singleline
Explanation:
○ Match '#'.
○ "key" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [^\n\r:;] atomically at least once.
○ Match ':'.
○ "value" capture group.
○ Match any character lazily any number of times.
○ Match ';'.
